results.name: Vite development server
results.detail: npm run dev serves the app; create/refresh/delete passed at localhost:5173.

results.name: Truthful initialization
results.detail: Initial HTML has loading/busy and disabled fieldsets until the held JS module runs, loads and validates real storage; no application timer or fake request.

results.name: Initial empty state
results.detail: Empty workspace, zero derived counts, and no automatic seed/storage write.

results.name: Form validation
results.detail: Whitespace title, programmatic overlength title/description, and out-of-range date rejected; inline associated errors and invalid/focus state verified.

results.name: Create/read and persistence
results.detail: Three trimmed tasks with distinct fields created without navigation; form reset/focus, summaries, JSON and refresh restoration verified.

results.name: Edit all fields and cancel
results.detail: Title, description, priority, status and due date updated with stable ID/createdAt and new updatedAt; refresh persisted; blank edit rejected; Escape and Cancel discarded drafts and restored focus.

results.name: Status and calendar behavior
results.detail: Complete/reopen survived refresh; overdue incomplete task counted; completed past-due task excluded; clearing a due date supported.

results.name: Live search
results.detail: Title and description, partial/mixed-case/padded/blank queries, no results, and clearing tested.

results.name: Every filter and combinations
results.detail: All status/priority options; search+status, search+priority, status+priority and all three combined; filtered empty state and reset verified.

results.name: All sorting modes
results.detail: Oldest/newest creation order, earliest due date with undated last, and high-to-low priority verified without mutating stored order.

results.name: Safe DOM rendering
results.detail: HTML-like title/description displayed literally, without injected nodes or script execution.

results.name: Delete correct record and persist
results.detail: Requested ID removed while other records remained; focus moved to a remaining delete control; deletion survived refresh.

results.name: Unexpected stale action
results.detail: Simulated stale task ID produced user-facing recovery feedback and a refreshed list without changing saved data or throwing uncaught errors.

results.name: Keyboard, labels and focus
results.detail: Enter creates/changes status/opens edit; Escape cancels; Tab enters description; visible focus, all control labels, real named buttons and associated errors verified.

results.name: Storage JSON inspection
results.detail: day15TaskManager parsed directly in the browser; unique IDs, eight expected serializable fields, valid timestamps, no DOM/functions.

results.name: No core reloads and notifications
results.detail: Core actions/search/filter/sort operate without navigation; create/update/delete/validation/stale feedback observed in the live status region.

results.detail: Create/read/edit all fields/status/search/combined filters/sort/reset/delete/refresh completed; long unbroken description, edit form, empty state fit; buttons/inputs/selects at least 44px high; no overflow.
